question: Who was the captain of the Indian hockey men's team at Olympic 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manpreet Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manpreet Singh:-**

 
 
• He plays **field hockey** for India.
 
• At the **2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo,** he led the** Indian field hockey team** to the bronze medal.
 
• He is a **halfback** for the team.
 
• He played for India at the** Olympics in 2012, **and in **2014**, he was voted **Asia's Junior Player of the Year.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amit Rohidas:**

 
 
• Indian field hockey player Amit Rohidas hails from **Odisha.**
 
• He is the** vice-captain** of the Indian national team and a **defender for the group.**
 
 
 
• **Sreejesh Ravindran:**
 
 
• **​**Sreejesh is a** former captain **of the Indian national team and a** goalkeeper **for the professional field hockey squad in India.
 
 
 
• **Krishan B Pathak:**
 
 
• **​**Indian field hockey player Krishan Bahadur Pathak serves as the** team's goalie for the national squad. **
